cards.p: Turn my site visit notes into a clear quote: line items, timeline, and what is not included: [paste].
Turn this quote into 3 options, good, better, best, with what changes in each: [paste].
Write a friendly text following up my quote for [job], sent [X] days ago. One question, no pressure.
Write a change order for [extra work]: what changes, new price [price], new date. Ask for a yes in writing.
Write a day before text for [customer]: arrival window [time], what to prep, and how to reach me.
Text [customer] that I am running [X] minutes late. Apologize once and give the new time.
Write a job done text for [job]: what we finished, care tips, invoice link [link], thank you.
Turn these job notes into a short progress update for the customer, plain words, what is next: [paste].
A customer got a cheaper quote. Reply in 3 lines that show my value without trashing anyone.
Explain my warranty on [service] in plain words: what it covers, how long, how to claim: [my terms].
Text [customer] that weather moves their [job]. Offer [option 1] or [option 2]. Let them reply 1 or 2.
Reply to this upset customer: [paste]. Calm, own what is fair, offer a visit to fix it.
Turn this job into a one page crew sheet: address, scope, materials, safety notes, photos to take: [paste].
Turn how I do [task] into a checklist a new helper can follow on day one.
Write a job post for a [role]: the work, hours, pay [range], must haves, 3 screening questions.
Turn these notes into tomorrow's team text: who goes where, what time, what to bring: [paste].
Write 3 captions for this before and after of a [job] in [city]. Short, real, end with how to book.
Write a Google Business Profile update about a recent [job] in [area]: what we did, plus one tip.
Write a door hanger for neighbors of a job on [street]: we were nearby, one offer, how to book.
Write a text asking a happy customer for a referral, with one easy way to share my number [number].
Invoice [number] for [job] is [X] days late. Write a firm, polite text with a pay by date and [link].
Write a deposit policy for my [trade]: [percent] up front, when it is due, what if they cancel.
Here are my costs for [job]: [paste]. Did I make money? Show the margin in a simple table.
Write a short note: my [service] goes to [new price] on [date]. One honest reason, no apologizing.
